limitations: Source-only conversational-model developmental extraction, not human labels; no model revision or decoding settings are pinned.

Only the four supplied source texts are used. Starbucks and Nike sources remain separate, with prefix cutoffs 2024-08-15 and 2024-09-20 respectively; no later realized appointments or departures are inferred.

observed_on uses each source’s supplied reported_publication_date to date the source observation. It is not an appointment boundary, verified timestamp, or operational availability date. The availability metadata explicitly labels its next-calendar-day rule as developmental and not verified publication.

All assertion context_source_ids are empty because each assertion is independently supported by its own source. Cross-source interpretation is confined to the separate ambiguity records; corroborating source assertions are not merged.

Date fields have exact-day precision only. Unknown exact starts, year-only CFO starts, and the unresolved Nike press-release exclusive end remain null. Scheduled end boundaries do not establish that the future events occurred.
No identifiable correction statement with a target is present; no CORRECTS operation or full correction is inferred from source order or differing dates.

Negative Starbucks departure assertions describe non-occupancy from the source-specific departure reading and must not be materialized as positive occupancy. No complete outgoing-tenure start is supplied.
